source: https://runescape.wiki/w/Distraction_%26_Diversion_reset_token_(daily|weekly|monthly) and the D&D pages (CC BY-NC-SA 3.0), read 2026-11-11
removal_note: the wiki's 2026 microtransaction items changes page lists all three reset tokens under 'Items to be removed' on 23 November 2026; items left are converted to coins at a reduced rate (the rate isn't given)
rules: a token resets one D&D of your choice, and each D&D only once per reset period (the game says 'You've already used a token for the <D&D> this month' on a second try)
daily D&Ds reset at 00:00 UTC, weekly ones on Wednesday 00:00 UTC, monthly ones on the 1st at 00:00 UTC
7 daily tokens convert into a weekly one and 4 weekly ones into a monthly one (the Convert option); nothing converts down

The Pit: a daily token grants the event at the next talent scout; Sinkholes: the token resets both daily rounds, but Talsar's three daily teleports don't come back (use the Prifddinas Dungeoneering portal)
Penguin Hide and Seek: a weekly token lets you spy another 10 agents too

not_valued.Champion's Challenge: re-fighting beaten champions pays xp lamps, but which champions you've beaten isn't exported
not_valued.Rush of Blood: the wiki gives no Slayer xp figure for a reward run; the reward book and chest aren't modelled
not_valued.Shattered Worlds challenges: anima only (250k/1m/7.5m for bronze/silver/gold), and the token resets your progress, not the challenge
